prd_locked.instructions: A locked PRD is present, and it names this one deliverable.
criteria: No locked document exists, and nothing names this one deliverable
A document describes the work, but it is not locked, or it is locked but does not name exactly this one deliverable
A locked PRD exists and names exactly this one deliverable

acceptance_stated.instructions: The acceptance check for this deliverable is stated.
criteria: No acceptance check is stated anywhere
Acceptance is described vaguely, with no pass/fail condition
A concrete acceptance check is stated that the work can be judged against

rung_outcome.instructions: The proposed non-negotiable outcome is a sound milestone bar for the bet it is meant to test.
criteria: The outcome is not falsifiable: two people could not agree on whether it passed, or it names no observable result.
The outcome is falsifiable, but what it tests is the mechanics of the build rather than whether the project's load-bearing assumption holds.
The outcome is falsifiable by a person who was not told the intent, and its failure would mean the load-bearing assumption is wrong.

rung_assumptions.instructions: The proposed assumptions are each actioned, and the set covers what the milestone's decisions rest on.
criteria: At least one named assumption has no invalidation trigger, or no consequence if it fails.
Every named assumption has both, but the set omits something the milestone's decisions actually rest on.
Every named assumption names what invalidates it and what follows, the load-bearing ones are identified, and the set covers what the milestone rests on.
